HOME-INV-01.requirement: Dashboard continua opcional: instalar, conectar, pedir, acompanhar, responder e obter resultado pelo terminal não ganha etapa web obrigatória.

HOME-INV-02.requirement: Server mantém autoridade de coordenação; Core executa; Connector hospeda execução remota. Esta frente não exige mudança de protocolo desses componentes por padrão.

HOME-INV-03.requirement: A Home lê/projeta fatos canônicos. Não mantém outra fila, máquina de estados de execução, scheduler ou agente interpretando eventos.
HOME-INV-03.scope: A08 remains read/query/controller-only; final current backend read-only qualification pending.

HOME-INV-04.requirement: Abrir, recarregar, filtrar ou expandir a Home não inicia inferência, aprova, completa trabalho, reivindica handoff, reconhece inbox ou amplia grant.

HOME-INV-05.requirement: Conectividade, presença, atividade, capacidade, admissão, aceitação nativa, resultado e verificação permanecem conceitos separados.

HOME-INV-06.requirement: Permissões de leitura de cada fonte valem para resumos, contadores, prévias, detalhes e links. Uma referência visível não concede capacidade de ação.
HOME-INV-06.scope: Current added Server read partition must preserve canonical authorization. Browser routed logout proves consumer clearing, not a fresh real-auth logout backend action.

HOME-INV-07.requirement: Ações continuam nas APIs existentes, com revisão, correlação, idempotência e revalidação atuais. Resultado desconhecido não autoriza replay.
HOME-INV-07.scope: Exact scope/CAS/nonrecipient refusal, interruption isolation and unknown-response nonreplay have executed evidence; no native application of recorded decision assumed.

HOME-INV-08.requirement: Identidade de agente é persistente e pode ter múltiplas sessões. A unidade primária da Home é uma atividade lógica, não o agent_id isolado.
HOME-INV-08.scope: Distinct executor/session/operation namespace and logical activity grouping are asserted, not inferred from agent status.

HOME-INV-09.requirement: Observação externa é identificada como reportada/inferida, com validade e origem. Não prova execução gerenciada nem conclusão de tarefa.
HOME-INV-09.scope: Live stream cannot renew stale external evidence, and Herdr completion never becomes native task success.

HOME-INV-10.requirement: Desabilitar a nova Home não muda nenhum desses contratos nem interfere nos agentes em execução.
HOME-INV-10.scope: Actual presentation toggle is proven, but live-cohort continuity is I01 and remains unverified.

M1.gap: Earlier real SQL/browser proves agent-to-agent work, concrete attention and results. Current added Server partition backend/browser/package must finish; shortcuts redesign alone would not satisfy M1.

M2.gap: Exact contextual controls and decision conflicts are qualified with canonical synthetic peers; no personal/native provider campaign or successful paid continuation inferred.

M3.gap: Current A08 final regression/browser/package/performance; actual H02 screen-reader output; I01 live cohort/presentation continuity; HOME033 consented real local campaign; comprehension test by a person unfamiliar with internal screens. Keep classic default; no production deployment.

non_numbered_requirements.human_comprehension_approximately_10_sec: NOT_RUN; cannot substitute an AI source review or screenshot assertion for an unfamiliar person.
non_numbered_requirements.overview_p95_500ms: NOT_MET_IN_PRIOR_FOUR_DATASETS; final A08 measurements must be identified separately. Targets may only be adjusted with recorded justification/baseline/comparison, not silently waived.
non_numbered_requirements.initial_useful_render_2seconds: Prior single browser sample1124ms, not render p95; scope and source cut remain explicit.
non_numbered_requirements.bounded_initial_payload: Prior11,172B max plus limits10work/3attention/6results; current added Server lane needs final payload accounting.
non_numbered_requirements.query_count_independent_of_agents: Prior constant46SQL/GET on four workloads; A08 antecedents show50 but are explicitly not final cut. No N+1 claim for the new cut without measurement.
non_numbered_requirements.reduced_motion: Existing global CSS has prefers-reduced-motion rule. This RO audit does not claim a fresh actual browser reduced-motion test.
non_numbered_requirements.screenshots: Existing synthetic360px and real200percent zoom PNGs at evidence/pr06-browser-final; final Server lane capture not yet present at audit time.
non_numbered_requirements.telemetry: No new external product telemetry consent is inferred. Current work must remain free of prompt/response/path/key/privateID telemetry.
non_numbered_requirements.core_connector: No change required by demonstrated contracts; repositories should remain clean/synchronized rather than receive invented protocol changes.
non_numbered_requirements.commits_pushes: Parent owns final commit/push and clean/synchronized confirmation for all outstanding changes before final delivery. This audit does not mutate Git or assert that the tree is currently clean.

conclusion: NOT COMPLETE. This is a requirement-by-requirement proposal, not a blanket product acceptance, release gate approval or authorization for a campaign. Pending work is concrete; old greens or plausible code do not establish its completion.
